speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray confirms free mediastinal air, and the crunching sound you're making indicates air has escaped into your tissues, consistent with a ruptured esophagus. DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave Syndrome (Spontaneous Esophageal Rupture).
